answer: Hold pseudonym parties. Four times a year, every operator who wants a minting seat must physically attend one of many meetups held worldwide in the same single hour, from a timber hall in Oslo to a mesa town in Arizona. Volunteers confirm each attendee is a body in the room, not a credential, and hand out one signed token per person, which grows like a vine into exactly one agent seat. Because every party happens at once, nobody can stand in two rooms, so a farm needs one real human per sybil.
